description: HTTPS certificate chain and cipher audit for a host (port 443) from Qualys SSL Labs' cached report: grade, number of certificates in the chain, trust store, TLS versions, weak-cipher count, Heartbleed/POODLE/BEAST flags and HSTS. Only reads reports SSL Labs already has, so a host that was never scanned returns a retry error instead of a new scan. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
